painPoints.heading: Struggling to Keep Your Website Current?
painPoints.text: As your product constantly evolves, it's often challenging to keep the website up-to-date while maintaining the highest design standards.

painPoints.heading: Unsatisfied with Current Design/Structure?
painPoints.text: When fully focused on the product, your website can become unstructured over time, affecting its design and overall impact.

painPoints.heading: No Budget for a Dedicated In-House Team?
painPoints.text: Top-tier designers and developers are expensive. Who can afford to hire A-players just for their product's website?

trust.heading:
Focus on your product –
we'll take care of the website
trust.text: We handle the design of your high-end website, including graphics, animations, and documentation pages. And we build it with modern frontend technologies – no Webflow, no Framer.

targets.heading: Outshine your competition
targets.text: Your perfectly designed website will elevate your SaaS to the level of industry giants like Linear or Stripe.

targets.heading: Generate more users or waitlist signups
targets.text: Great landing pages resonate better with potential users and grab attention on Twitter, ProductHunt, etc.

targets.heading: Your website grows magically with your product
targets.text: While you develop new product features, we take care of the corresponding feature pages on your website.

steps.heading: Subscribe & Submit Requests
steps.text: Subscribe in just a minute and gain access to your personalized request board. Start with tips on getting the most out of your subscription. When you're ready for a top-tier website, submit as many requests as you want – we work through them one by one.

steps.heading: Design & Development
steps.text: We'll tackle your active request today or tomorrow (business days). You'll be notified once it's complete – typically taking around 48 hours for design requests and approximately 96 hours for development requests. This may vary depending on the scope of the request.

steps.heading: Optimization & Expansion
steps.text: After a request is fulfilled, provide your feedback. We'll refine the results until you're 100% satisfied. As you develop new product features, simply submit new requests for website updates or entire feature pages. Your website magically grows with your product.

design.heading:
Cutting-Edge Design,
tailored for your SaaS Product
design.text: We prioritize exceptional design, knowing it not only attracts more users but also generates social media buzz. Our design process is optimized for Figma, enabling easy previews and prototype viewing.

categories.heading:
Compelling Landing &
Feature Pages
categories.text: With conversion-optimized landing pages, potential users understand why they need your product and are motivated to sign up.

categories.heading:
Beautifully Crafted
Graphics & Animations
categories.text: Show, don't tell: To clearly explain your product and its benefits, we create high-quality graphics and animations for your website.

categories.heading:
Clear and Organized
Documentation Pages
categories.text: Structuring documentation can be tough. We find the best way to design and build your docs for clarity and ease of use.

development.heading:
No Webflow, No Framer,
but Real Next.js Development
development.text: While low-code builders are okay for quick landing pages, we believe nothing beats a modern frontend stack long-term. It gives us full control over design and animations, allowing seamless integration of payments, CMS, search, bookings, and more.

call.heading: Not sure if it's right for you?
call.text: We provide premium services. If you're uncertain whether our service fits your business or product, feel free to book a call with our founder, Lukas.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text: We're committed to transparency. If anything is unclear, feel free to book a call with our founder, Lukas.

questions.a: No – you can add as many requests to your board as you want. However, we work on one active request at a time.

questions.q: What types of designs are included?
questions.a: Anything related to your website, including UI, graphics, icons, and illustrations. If you don't have branding yet, we can handle that too.

questions.q: What tech stack do you use?
questions.a: Your website will be built using Next.js and TailwindCSS. We believe a modern stack provides the best foundation for future updates and expansions.
Absolutely. We can integrate anything with an API, such as payment providers, CMS, search, and Google services.

questions.q: Do you also develop our product?
questions.a: No. Product development requires dedicated time and focus. Our passion is building exceptional websites. We handle everything website-related, so you can focus on building the best product for your users.

questions.q: Why not just hire a full-time employee?
questions.a: We offer these services because we know how hard it is to find A-players and how expensive it is to hire them full-time. Our subscription is a more affordable and flexible solution to build a top-tier website for your product.

questions.q: What sets you apart from similar services?
questions.a: While subscription-based agencies are growing – which is great – we're the first to offer top-tier design AND professional development instead of Webflow/Framer.
